device.category: monophonic semi-modular analogue synthesizer, desktop or Eurorack, with sequencer and arpeggiator
device.based_on: Behringer cites the Moog Model 15 modular circuits; reviewers note the layout and feature set copy the Moog Grandmother (2018), itself built from Moog modular circuits.

sources.title: Behringer MODEL 15 Quick Start Guide
sources.note: Multilingual; English controls (93 callouts), getting started, sequencer and specifications used. Patch sheets are blank.

sources.title: B&H Photo, Synthtopia and Synth Anatomy product coverage
sources.note: Grandmother comparison, 25 in / 23 out patch bay, 24 dB ladder filter, spring reverb emulation.

sources.title: Moog Grandmother Owner's Manual
sources.note: The instrument the Model 15 copies. Its documented normals, summing pitch inputs, S&H source and attenuator reference are applied here as inferred.

architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound memory; three sequencer slots of up to 256 steps each.
architecture.summary: Two VCOs with four waveforms each, sync, PWM and a sub-oscillator, mixed with noise into a 24 dB ladder low-pass filter, with a separate 6 dB high-pass filter in the patch bay. One ADSR, a VCA that follows the envelope, the key release or stays open, an LFO reaching 1.3 kHz, sample and hold, an attenuverter, spring reverb emulation, and an arpeggiator and three-slot sequencer. Plays without patching; 48 jacks override or extend the internal routing.

modules.name: MIDI to CV
modules.description: Converts MIDI notes (DIN or USB) to note CV, gate and velocity, through the arpeggiator/sequencer when running.

modules.name: Arpeggiator / sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator over 1-3 octaves, or a step sequencer with three slots of up to 256 steps (notes, ties, rests, accents), transposed from the keyboard. Runs from its RATE, tap tempo or an external clock, and sends clock out.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Triangle, sawtooth, square or narrow pulse at 32', 16', 8' or 4'.

modules.name: Oscillator 2 and sub
modules.description: Triangle, sawtooth, square or narrow pulse at 16'-2', detunable ±7 semitones, with hard sync to Oscillator 1, linear FM input and a sub-oscillator output.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Three channels: Oscillator 1, Oscillator 2, and sub/white noise.

modules.name: High-pass filter
modules.description: 6 dB/oct high-pass, active only when patched.

modules.name: Ladder filter
modules.description: 24 dB/oct resonant ladder low-pass, 20 Hz-20 kHz, with key tracking and a bipolar envelope amount.

modules.name: Envelope
modules.description: ADSR: attack 2 ms-16 s, decay 2 ms-40 s, sustain 0-8 V, release 2 ms-20 s, with normal and inverted outputs.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Follows the envelope, opens only on key release ('KEYBOARD RELEASE'), or stays open (DRONE).

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Sine, sawtooth, ramp or square, 0.07 Hz-1.3 kHz, with reset and rate inputs.

modules.name: Attenuverter
modules.description: Bipolar attenuator: centre is off, clockwise passes the input, anticlockwise passes it inverted.

modules.name: Attenuator reference
modules.description: Internal positive voltage normalled to the attenuator input, as on the Grandmother.

modules.name: Reverb
modules.description: Spring reverb emulation with dry/wet MIX; has its own patch input and output.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Main volume to the 3.5 mm and 6.35 mm outputs; separate headphone volume.

modules.name: MULTI 1
modules.description: Passive multiple; the specifications count its three jacks as inputs.

modules.name: MULTI 2
modules.description: Passive multiple; the specifications count its three jacks as outputs.

parameters.label: MODE
parameters.function: Arpeggiator, sequencer playback or sequencer record.

parameters.label: DIRECTION
parameters.function: ORDR: order played or start to end. <</>>: forwards then back. RNDM: random.

parameters.label: OCT/SEQ
parameters.function: Arpeggio range in octaves, or the sequence slot to play or record.

parameters.label: GLIDE
parameters.function: Glide time between notes; minimum is off.

parameters.label: PLAY/TIE
parameters.function: Starts the ARP/SEQ; enters a tie in sequencer record.

parameters.label: HOLD/REST
parameters.function: Keeps the ARP/SEQ playing; enters a rest in sequencer record.

parameters.label: TAP/ACCENT
parameters.function: Three or more taps set the tempo (hold to exit); adds an accent step in sequencer record.

parameters.label: PITCH MOD
parameters.function: Maximum LFO depth on both oscillators' pitch.

parameters.label: PULSE WIDTH
parameters.function: Maximum LFO depth on the square and narrow pulse widths of both oscillators.

parameters.label: WAVEFORM OSC 2/SUB
parameters.function: Waveform for Oscillator 2 or the sub-oscillator.
parameters.note: The guide says it selects the waveform 'for OSC 2 or the SUB Oscillator' without saying how the choice between them is made.

parameters.label: ATTENUATOR
parameters.function: Centre off; clockwise towards unity, anticlockwise towards unity inverted.

parameters.label: MODULATION
parameters.function: Overall amount of LFO modulation reaching cutoff, pitch and pulse width.

parameters.label: VCA MODE
parameters.function: Envelope, keyboard release, or drone (always open).

parameters.label: OUT/THRU

access.note: SynthTribe output parameters: MIDI (DIN), MIDI (USB) or both

parameters.function: Whether the MIDI DIN socket sends MIDI out or passes MIDI in through.
parameters.note: The guide does not say how OUT/THRU is chosen.

ports.label: AUDIO INPUT
ports.function: External or internal audio; assumed to enter mixer channel 3.
ports.note: The guide only says 'used to input external or internal audio'.

ports.label: MIX 1
ports.function: Mixer channel 1 input; replaces its internal source.

ports.label: MIX 2
ports.function: Mixer channel 2 input; replaces its internal source.

ports.label: MIX 3
ports.function: Mixer channel 3 input; replaces its internal source.

ports.label: FILTER INPUT
ports.function: Into the ladder filter; replaces the mixer feed.

ports.label: OSC 1 PWM
ports.function: Pulse width of Oscillator 1's square or narrow pulse, 0 to +5 V.

ports.label: ENV AMT
ports.function: CV control of the envelope amount, -8 to +8 V.

ports.label: OSC 1 CV
ports.function: Pitch of Oscillator 1; summed with the keyboard CV.

ports.label: OSC 2 CV
ports.function: Pitch of Oscillator 2; summed with the keyboard CV.

ports.label: ENV TRIG
ports.function: Envelope trigger, above 2.5 V; replaces the keyboard gate.

ports.label: VCA INPUT
ports.function: Audio into the VCA; disconnects the filter output.

ports.label: VCA CV
ports.function: Controls overall volume, 0 to +8 V in DRONE.

ports.label: ATT INPUT
ports.function: Attenuverter input, -8 to +8 V; unpatched, it reads an internal positive reference.

ports.label: ARP/SEQ SYN
ports.function: External clock for the ARP/SEQ, above 2.5 V.

ports.label: ARP/SEQ RES
ports.function: Resets the pattern to its start.

ports.label: ARP/SEQ ON
ports.function: Starts the ARP/SEQ: 0 V off, +5 V on.

ports.label: VELOCITY
ports.function: MIDI velocity as CV; carries sequencer accents. 0 to +5 V.

ports.label: SYNC
ports.function: Clock out to slave other gear, 0 to +5 V.

ports.label: AUDIO OUTPUT
ports.function: Main output, 6.35 mm TS, up to +5.8 dBu.

connections.note: Fixed, not normalled: on the Grandmother, OSC PITCH IN adds to the keyboard CV.
Mixer 3 is labelled 'OSC 3/White Noise' in the controls and 'Sub / white noise' in the specifications.
Dry/wet mix of the VCA signal and reverb.
Unpatched, the attenuator becomes a DC source of up to ±8 V, as on the Grandmother.
The Grandmother manual states the S&H samples noise; the Model 15 guide does not say, and has white and pink noise.
Samples at each zero crossing of the LFO, per the Grandmother manual.

indicators.label: TAP light
indicators.function: Lit while tap tempo is on.

behaviours.name: Default signal path
behaviours.rule: Without cables: keyboard CV to both oscillators and (by KEY TRACKING) the filter; gate to the envelope; oscillators and sub/noise through the mixer into the ladder filter, then the VCA, reverb and output. The high-pass filter, sample and hold and attenuverter are only in circuit when patched. Patching MIX 1-3, FILTER INPUT, VCA INPUT, REVERB INPUT or ENV TRIG replaces its normal; OSC 1/2 CV add to the keyboard pitch rather than replacing it. Unpatched, the attenuator outputs a DC voltage set by its knob.
behaviours.note: Only the filter-to-VCA normal is stated in the Model 15 guide; the rest follows the Moog Grandmother owner's manual.

behaviours.name: VCA modes
behaviours.rule: ENV: the VCA follows the envelope. RELEASE ('keyboard release'): the envelope's release shapes the note end. DRONE: the VCA stays open, and VCA CV sets the level.

behaviours.name: LFO depths
behaviours.rule: PITCH MOD, PULSE WIDTH and FILTER MOD set the maximum LFO depth for each destination; MODULATION sets how much of those depths is applied.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: In ARP mode, held notes play in order played (ORDR), forwards then back (<</>>) or randomly (RNDM), over 1-3 octaves. HOLD keeps it running. Tempo from RATE, three or more TAPs, or ARP/SEQ SYN.

behaviours.name: Sequencer
behaviours.rule: Three slots of up to 256 steps. MODE to REC, choose the slot with OCT/SEQ, then play notes; REST adds a blank step, TIE joins a repeated note, overlapping notes play legato, ACCENT marks a step on the VELOCITY output. MODE back to SEQ ends recording. PLAY then a key starts it, and new keys transpose. Editing only works while playing (switch to REC during playback); pressing a key in REC while stopped erases the slot.

behaviours.name: Accents
behaviours.rule: Accents leave on the VELOCITY jack; patch it to CUTOFF (or FILTER IN, per the controls text) to hear them.

behaviours.name: Warm-up
behaviours.rule: Allow 15 minutes or more, longer from cold.

midi.channel_note: Receive channel 1-16 by rear DIP switches; MIDI output routing (DIN, USB, both) in SynthTribe.
midi.note: The quick start guide lists no controller, clock or program messages.

outputs.main: 1/4" TS, max +5.8 dBu; 3.5 mm on the patch bay

source_inconsistencies: Mixer 3 is 'OSC 3/White Noise' in the controls but 'Sub / white noise' in the specifications; there is no Oscillator 3.
The controls text says to patch VELOCITY to FILTER IN to hear accents; the getting-started text suggests CUTOFF IN, which is the CV input.
The specifications list MULTI 1 as three inputs and MULTI 2 as three outputs; passive multiples have no direction.

modelling_gaps.detail: Taken from the Moog Grandmother owner's manual. The Model 15 departs from the Grandmother in places (sub-oscillator, pink noise, reverb emulation), so a hands-on check would confirm them.
An emulation of a spring; its character is not documented.
Waveform selection and octave relationship unclear from the guide.
